Fixed by objectstack-ai/objectui#2771 (merged).

**What was done** — a renderer-only fix in ObjectUI's `SchemaForm`. The repeater now resolves the `sort` union (`anyOf: [string, {field,order}[]]`) to its array branch before reading `items`, so the Sort field renders the field picker + order (`asc`/`desc`) dropdown instead of a blank row. Covered by a new unit test (`SchemaForm.repeaterUnion.test.tsx`) and verified end-to-end in a real browser (empty Sort row → `Field` + `Order` controls).

**Scope note — the suggested spec change was intentionally _not_ made.** This issue proposed dropping the legacy bare-string variant from `ListViewSchema.sort`. That was **not** done, because `view.zod.ts` carries an explicit instruction directly above `sort` — *"Removal will go through its own deprecation cycle; do not drop it here"* — and the string form is kept covered by a live fixture (`examples/app-showcase/.../task.view.ts`, guarding objectui#2601). Dropping it would break that fixture and be a breaking change to the public spec. Per #3373 the union was kept intentionally, so the spec-side removal remains its own separate, deferred deprecation cycle and is **not** closed by this fix.

Closing as completed since the user-facing bug (blank Sort repeater in Edit View Config) is resolved.
